Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the products of the neutralization reaction between HCl and NaOH. It claimed the products were "NaCl and OH" (Option B), failing to recognize that the hydroxide ion (OH⁻) from the base reacts with the hydrogen ion (H⁺) from the acid to form water (H₂O). This is a fundamental error in applying chemical principles (acid-base neutralization) where the correct products are a salt (NaCl) and water (H₂O), corresponding to Option D. The agent also prematurely declared the task complete without verifying the chemical validity of its conclusion against standard reaction types.
